displayScope: One direct Gossamer arc-chain prototype cast; actual entities within 20 blocks of scene; sequential queries are not an atomic tick snapshot
review: 台形素材で帯の内側の大きな重なりを解消。区間境界の細い隙間、外周の角・発光、白い残光・花模様、残像の衣服と姿勢、刀の曲率、カメラは未一致。通常入力・状態分岐・正式キット対応は未確定。
comparison: Near-full rise arc: round84 frame24 versus round85 frame26. Match visual phase, not raw frame number. Large triangular overlap wedges eliminated; thin pixel seams remain.
implementation: Optional glyph on soft trail bands. Glyph bands use outer chord width and no rectangular overlap. Back faces turn about local X to preserve radial taper; glyph is symmetric along chord. Gossamer inner-band128px white trapezoid tapers chord extent from63% at root to100% at tip, matching radius1.25/1.981 approximately. Extra8px/ascent7 font is reproducibly generated via quad_font. Existing rectangle bands retain calibration and overlap.
limits: Static taper is specific to this radial geometry, not automatic swept-mesh reconstruction. Glyph fields require8px calibration; double-sided glyphs should be chord-symmetric. Fine seams and polygonal exterior remain. Initial pack lacked auxiliary font because generator cleans outputs; detected by content dependency check before capture, then fixed generation and repacked. No tests run; builds/contentLint and actual client checked.
